name: AN Funnel Customers
expression: VAR F = SELECTEDVALUE('AN Funnels'[Funnel Name], "Campaign") VAR D = SELECTEDVALUE('AN Funnels'[Segment Dimension], "All") RETURN CALCULATE(SUM('AN Funnels'[Customers]), KEEPFILTERS('AN Funnels'[Funnel Name] = F), KEEPFILTERS('AN Funnels'[Segment Dimension] = D))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO ANALYTICS. Funnel Customers. All experiment effects are simulated; attribution is not causal.

name: AN Funnel Drop Off
expression: VAR F = SELECTEDVALUE('AN Funnels'[Funnel Name], "Campaign") VAR D = SELECTEDVALUE('AN Funnels'[Segment Dimension], "All") RETURN CALCULATE(SUM('AN Funnels'[Drop Off]), KEEPFILTERS('AN Funnels'[Funnel Name] = F), KEEPFILTERS('AN Funnels'[Segment Dimension] = D))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO ANALYTICS. Funnel Drop Off. All experiment effects are simulated; attribution is not causal.

name: AN Funnel Rate
expression: VAR F = SELECTEDVALUE('AN Funnels'[Funnel Name], "Campaign") VAR D = SELECTEDVALUE('AN Funnels'[Segment Dimension], "All") RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('AN Funnels'[Conversion From Start]), KEEPFILTERS('AN Funnels'[Funnel Name] = F), KEEPFILTERS('AN Funnels'[Segment Dimension] = D))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO ANALYTICS. Funnel Rate. All experiment effects are simulated; attribution is not causal.

name: AN Primary Bank Customers
expression: CALCULATE(SUM('AN Funnels'[Customers]), KEEPFILTERS('AN Funnels'[Funnel Name] = "Primary Bank Journey"), KEEPFILTERS('AN Funnels'[Segment Dimension] = "All"))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO ANALYTICS. Primary Bank Customers. All experiment effects are simulated; attribution is not causal.

name: AN Digital Retention
expression: VAR C = SELECTEDVALUE('AN Cohorts'[Cohort Type], "First Digital Activity") RETURN CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('AN Cohorts'[Retained Customers]), SUM('AN Cohorts'[Customers])), KEEPFILTERS('AN Cohorts'[Cohort Type] = C), KEEPFILTERS('AN Cohorts'[Small Sample] = FALSE()))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO ANALYTICS. Digital Retention. All experiment effects are simulated; attribution is not causal.

name: AN Product Retention
expression: CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('AN Cohorts'[Product Retained Customers]), SUM('AN Cohorts'[Customers])), KEEPFILTERS('AN Cohorts'[Cohort Type] = "Product Acquisition"))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO ANALYTICS. Product Retention. All experiment effects are simulated; attribution is not causal.

name: AN Segment Digital Retention
expression: VAR C = SELECTEDVALUE('AN Cohorts'[Cohort Type], "First Digital Activity") RETURN CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('AN Retention Segments'[Retained Customers]), SUM('AN Retention Segments'[Customers])), KEEPFILTERS('AN Retention Segments'[Cohort Type] = C))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO ANALYTICS. Segment Digital Retention. All experiment effects are simulated; attribution is not causal.

name: AN Retention Cell Color
expression: VAR R = [AN Digital Retention] RETURN IF(ISBLANK(R), "#FFFFFF", SWITCH(TRUE(), R >= 0.75, "#167D9A", R >= 0.50, "#71B6C7", R >= 0.25, "#BDDCE5", "#EEF5F8"))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO ANALYTICS. Retention Cell Color. All experiment effects are simulated; attribution is not causal.

name: AN Service Cohort Digital Retention
expression: CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('AN Cohorts'[Retained Customers]), SUM('AN Cohorts'[Customers])), KEEPFILTERS('AN Cohorts'[Cohort Type] = "Service Activation"))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO ANALYTICS. Service Cohort Digital Retention. All experiment effects are simulated; attribution is not causal.

name: AN Cohort Engagement
expression: VAR C = SELECTEDVALUE('AN Cohorts'[Cohort Type], "First Digital Activity") RETURN CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUMX('AN Cohorts', 'AN Cohorts'[Average Engagement Score] * 'AN Cohorts'[Customers]), SUM('AN Cohorts'[Customers])), KEEPFILTERS('AN Cohorts'[Cohort Type] = C))
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO ANALYTICS. Cohort Engagement. All experiment effects are simulated; attribution is not causal.

name: AN Primary Journey Narrative
expression: VAR T = TOPN(1, FILTER(ALL('AN Funnels'), 'AN Funnels'[Funnel Name] = "Primary Bank Journey" && 'AN Funnels'[Segment Dimension] = "All" && 'AN Funnels'[Stage Order] > 0), 'AN Funnels'[Drop Off], DESC, 'AN Funnels'[Stage Order], ASC) RETURN "Largest cross-sectional readiness drop-off: " & CONCATENATEX(T, 'AN Funnels'[Stage], "") & " (" & FORMAT(MAXX(T, 'AN Funnels'[Drop Off]), "#,0") & " customers). This is a nested snapshot, not longitudinal conversion."
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO ANALYTICS. Primary Journey Narrative. All experiment effects are simulated; attribution is not causal.

name: AN Payroll Experiment Narrative
expression: VAR L = CALCULATE(MAX('AN Experiments'[Absolute Lift]), REMOVEFILTERS('AN Experiments'), 'AN Experiments'[Experiment Id] = "EXP001") VAR D = CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE('AN Experiments'[Experiment Decision]), REMOVEFILTERS('AN Experiments'), 'AN Experiments'[Experiment Id] = "EXP001") RETURN "Simulated payroll lift: " & FORMAT(100 * L, "0.0") & " percentage points; decision: " & D & "."
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO ANALYTICS. Payroll Experiment Narrative. All experiment effects are simulated; attribution is not causal.
